name: crontab_gsocket_defunct
description: A gsocket persistence crontab: base64 piped to bash relaunches a hidden binary as [kworker] under the defunct-kernel marker. suspicious_crontab has only an operator fix (quarantine and truncate): no responder acts on it in realtime, and the full scan keeps it off its quarantine list.

tier.gap: the deep tier runs no crontab check; only the critical tier's crontabs check reads the spool
